description: This file defines custom exception classes for the Superset project, including specific error types for command operations, validation errors, and resource not found errors.

classes.name: CommandException
classes.description: Base class for command-related exceptions, extending SupersetException.

classes.name: ObjectNotFoundError
classes.description: Error indicating a specific object was not found, with customizable object type and ID.

classes.name: CommandInvalidError
classes.description: Represents validation errors for commands, holding multiple ValidationError instances.

classes.name: UpdateFailedError
classes.description: Indicates failure during a command update operation.

classes.name: CreateFailedError
classes.description: Indicates failure during a command creation operation.

classes.name: DeleteFailedError
classes.description: Indicates failure during a command delete operation.

classes.name: ForbiddenError
classes.description: Represents an action that is forbidden.

classes.name: ImportFailedError
classes.description: Indicates failure during an import operation.

classes.name: DatasourceTypeInvalidError
classes.description: Validation error for invalid datasource type.

classes.name: DatasourceNotFoundValidationError
classes.description: Validation error when datasource does not exist.

classes.name: QueryNotFoundValidationError
classes.description: Validation error when query does not exist.

classes.name: TagForbiddenError
classes.description: Error indicating forbidden access to tags.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructors for various exception classes, initializing error messages and fields.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds a ValidationError to the CommandInvalidError's list.

methods.name: extend
methods.description: Extends the list of ValidationErrors in CommandInvalidError.

methods.name: get_list_classnames
methods.description: Returns sorted list of unique class names of contained ValidationErrors.

methods.name: normalized_messages
methods.description: Aggregates normalized messages from contained ValidationErrors.
